result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render correctly. The only visually broken element is the third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, whose restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped mid-word at the right screen edge without any fade or scroll affordance; per instructions this edge-clipped carousel item is treated as expected behavior, so no defects are reported.
